title: A save that throws on the value page's Add says nothing: the button comes back and the typed value stays, but no message shows
evidence: Seen building US-03 AC2a (the PR replacing PR 1744): AddValue's add() (widget-src/src/components/ValuePage.tsx) now frees its claim (withClaim, lib/sync-claim.ts) and the Add button when the save ends, so a throw from onSave (the store's write failing, useLongitudinalSave rethrows) leaves the form ready to retry; the throw still escapes the submit as an unhandled rejection, and the page shows nothing. Test: HealthTool.double-commit.test.tsx 'a save that throws: the Add button comes back enabled, and the next Add saves'. The words are Brad's call; a draft, not yet approved: "Your value could not be saved. Try again." (the matrices' nearest line is SAVE_FAILED, "Some values did not save. Try again."). Until he says yes, no new words go in the UI.
